{{Quote|Human life is so short. They don't ask much of us. Organics created us. It's the least we can do.|Unidentified bartender droid to [[Din Djarin]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze]].|<ref name="Chapter 22" />}}
An '''unidentified bartender droid''' managed the [[droid cantina]] [[The Resistor]] on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]] in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|22}}</ref> When [[Mandalorian]]s [[Din Djarin]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] arrived at the [[cantina]] to investigate a suspicious [[spark pad]] carried by one of Plazir's malfunctioning [[droid]]s, the [[bartender droid]] attempted to dissuade them from investigating its patrons. With Djarin turning violent, the bartender ultimately pleaded with the Mandalorians to allow them and their patrons to assist them with their work since they had nothing but the well-being of their organic creators in mind. Djarin accepted the offer and the bartender successfully identified the common factor between all malfunctioning droids; a spiked batch of [[Nepenthé]] which had been laced with [[NM-K reconstitutor|nano-droids]] to reprogram the droids.<ref name="Chapter 22">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}}</ref>
